title: Horizon Feedback Shape
description: Emitted by the Horizon HTML surface when the user validates the plan. The agent reads this to decide whether to proceed to execution or loop back.

verdict.description: approved → proceed to Phase 3. changes-requested → loop back to the flagged section.

decisions.description: Answers to openQuestions and edits to evidence/positioning fields, keyed by the referenced id.

ref.description: id of an openQuestion (q*), evidence (e*), node (n*), or a dotted path like positioning.problem

edit.description: replacement/edited value for the referenced field

approvals.description: Per-section sign-off. Any 'change' with verdict 'approved' is a contradiction the agent must resolve before proceeding.
